tools.name: abraflexi_get_company
tools.description: Show the ABRA Flexi company the login points to (name, company id, state). Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_evidences
tools.description: List the evidences (tables) of the company with their Czech path and name, for example faktura-vydana = issued invoices, adresar = address book, cenik = price list. Use a path from here as 'evidence' in abraflexi_list_records / abraflexi_get_record (only business evidences are readable there).

tools.name: abraflexi_list_issued_invoices
tools.description: List issued invoices (sales invoices to customers), newest first by default, filtered by payment status, customer/supplier code, dates or text. Money fields: sumCelkem = total, zbyvaUhradit = still to pay (in the company currency), the *Men fields are in the document currency. Returns total, next_st

tools.name: abraflexi_get_issued_invoice
tools.description: Get one issued invoice with all its fields and its line items. Pass the numeric id (from the list) or an identifier such as code:<number>.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_received_invoices
tools.description: List received invoices (bills from suppliers), newest first by default, filtered by payment status, customer/supplier code, dates or text. Money fields: sumCelkem = total, zbyvaUhradit = still to pay (in the company currency), the *Men fields are in the document currency. Returns total, next_start f

tools.name: abraflexi_get_received_invoice
tools.description: Get one received invoice with all its fields and its line items. Pass the numeric id (from the list) or an identifier such as code:<number>.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search the address book (adresar): customers and suppliers with code (kod), name, company id (ic), VAT id (dic), e-mail, phone and address. The code from here identifies the customer in invoices.

tools.name: abraflexi_get_contact
tools.description: Get one address-book entry with all its fields. Pass the numeric id (from abraflexi_list_contacts) or code:<kod>.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_products
tools.description: List or search the price list (cenik): products and services with code, name, EAN, prices (without and with VAT), purchase price and whether they are stocked.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_stock_cards
tools.description: List stock cards (skladova-karta): the quantity on hand (stavMJ), reserved (rezervMJ) and available (dostupMj) per product and warehouse, with min/max limits and average price.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_stock_movements
tools.description: List stock movements (skladovy-pohyb: receipts, issues, transfers), newest first by default, filtered by warehouse or dates.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_bank_movements
tools.description: List bank movements (banka: bank statement lines, incoming and outgoing payments), newest first by default, filtered by dates, bank account, variable symbol or text. sumCelkem is the amount; typPohybuK says incoming or outgoing.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_cash_movements
tools.description: List cash desk movements (pokladni-pohyb: cash receipts and payouts), newest first by default, filtered by dates, cash desk, variable symbol or text. sumCelkem is the amount; typPohybuK says incoming or outgoing.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_orders
tools.description: List orders: direction 'received' = customer orders (objednavka-prijata, default), 'issued' = purchase orders to suppliers (objednavka-vydana). Newest first by default.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_records
tools.description: List records of any business evidence (invoice types, bank accounts, warehouses, cost centres, currencies, ledger entries, price-list items, ...) with an optional filter in ABRA Flexi's filter language, for example filter "zbyvaUhradit > 0 and datSplat < now()" or "kod = 'ABC'". Operators: = <> < <=

tools.name: abraflexi_get_record
tools.description: Get one record of any business evidence with all its fields (detail full), by numeric id or identifier such as code:ABC. Field names are the vendor's Czech property names.

tools.name: abraflexi_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new address-book entry (customer or supplier) in ABRA Flexi. It only adds a record; nothing is sent. Use dry_run first to see the result without saving. Check abraflexi_list_contacts first so you do not create a duplicate.

tools.name: abraflexi_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing address-book entry (only the fields you pass are changed). The entry must exist (a wrong id is an error, nothing is created). This overwrites the current values. Use dry_run first to check.

tools.name: abraflexi_create_issued_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create an issued invoice (faktura-vydana) with line items in ABRA Flexi. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: abraflexi_list_stock_movements · Private data: abraflexi_list_issued_invoices, abraflexi_list_received_invoices, abraflexi_list_contacts, abraflexi_get_contact, abraflexi_list_records, abraflexi_get_record, abraflexi_create_contact, abraflexi_update_contact, abraflexi_create_issued_invoice · Public sink: abraflexi_create_issued_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: abraflexi_list_stock_movements · Private data: abraflexi_list_issued_invoices, abraflexi_list_received_invoices, abraflexi_list_contacts, abraflexi_get_contact, abraflexi_list_records, abraflexi_get_record, abraflexi_create_contact, abraflexi_update_contact, abraflexi_create_issued_invoice · Public sink: abraflexi_create_issued_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
